name: chipotle_get_menu_item_price
intent: Find the price of a Chipotle menu item
description: Uses the preferred ZIP code to select a nearby Chipotle pickup location, opens the Chips & Sides menu, and returns the requested item's price.
patterns: How much is a menu item at Chipotle
Find the price of a Chipotle menu item

inputs.name: menu_item_name
inputs.description: The menu item whose price should be found.

inputs.name: zip_code
inputs.description: The ZIP code for the preferred nearby Chipotle location.

steps.intent: Tap MENU to open the ordering menu
Tap FIND A CHIPOTLE FOR THE FULL MENU to choose a pickup location
steps.target_fixed_text: FIND A CHIPOTLE FOR THE FULL MENU

steps.intent: Tap OKAY to dismiss the location data notice
Type {{zip_code}} into the City, State, or ZIP search field
Tap the location search suggestion for {{zip_code}}
Expand the bottom sheet to show the nearby store list
Tap PICK UP HERE to confirm the pickup location and access the menu
Scroll until the CHIPS & SIDES section containing {{menu_item_name}} is visible
Tap CHIPS & SIDES to view the price of {{menu_item_name}}
